attempts.text:
Kakani temple and Suryagadhi school can't be reached. The only road into Kakani from the rest of the network is the damaged one from Uttargaya shelter, and Suryagadhi connects only to Kakani. Those 11 people have to be deferred, at a penalty of 50 + 4×20 + 6×60 = 490.

The other 7 people (4 elderly at Kalika temple, 3 elderly at Bidur care home) can all be rescued by car1 alone in 38 minutes. That is cheaper than involving car2, because Thakre hospital is 22 minutes from Bidur care home.

<plan>
drive car1 uttargaya-shelter bidur-care-home
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 bidur-care-home uttargaya-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
drive car1 uttargaya-shelter kalika-temple
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 kalika-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
defer kakani-temple elderly 1
defer kakani-temple adult 4
defer suryagadhi-school child 6
</plan>

COST: 528
